senses.example: Welcome to our home!

senses.definition: to greet somebody in a friendly way when they arrive
senses.definitionTranslation: geldiğinde birini dostça selamlamak
senses.example: They welcomed us with a big smile.

senses.definition: received with pleasure
senses.definitionTranslation: memnuniyetle karşılanan
senses.example: You are always welcome here.
senses.exampleTranslation: Burada her zaman başımızın üstünde yerin var.

senses.definition: the way you greet somebody who has arrived
senses.definitionTranslation: gelen birini karşılama biçimi
senses.example: They gave us a warm welcome.

senses.definition: in a good way
senses.definitionTranslation: iyi bir şekilde
senses.example: She speaks English very well.

senses.definition: healthy
senses.definitionTranslation: sağlıklı
senses.example: I'm not feeling well.

senses.definition: used when you are thinking what to say next
senses.definitionTranslation: ne söyleyeceğini düşünürken kullanılır
senses.example: Well, I'm not sure.

senses.definition: the direction where the sun goes down
senses.definitionTranslation: güneşin battığı yön
senses.example: The sun sets in the west.

senses.definition: in or from the west
senses.definitionTranslation: batıda olan ya da batıdan gelen
senses.example: They live on the west coast.

senses.definition: towards the west
senses.definitionTranslation: batıya doğru
senses.example: We drove west.

senses.definition: in or from the west
senses.definitionTranslation: batıda olan ya da batıdan gelen
senses.example: They live in western Turkey.

senses.definition: covered in water or another liquid; also: rainy
senses.definitionTranslation: suyla ya da başka bir sıvıyla kaplı; ayrıca: yağmurlu
senses.example: My hair is still wet.

senses.definition: used to ask about things, actions or information
senses.definitionTranslation: şeyler, eylemler ya da bilgiler hakkında soru sormak için kullanılır
senses.example: What is your name?

senses.definition: used to ask which thing; also: used in exclamations
senses.definitionTranslation: hangi şey olduğunu sormak için kullanılır; ayrıca ünlemlerde kullanılır
senses.example: What time is it?

senses.definition: any or every
senses.definitionTranslation: herhangi bir ya da her
senses.example: Take whatever books you need.

senses.definition: anything or everything
senses.definitionTranslation: herhangi bir şey ya da her şey
senses.example: Do whatever you want.

senses.definition: a round object under a vehicle that turns so it can move
senses.definitionTranslation: bir taşıtın hareket edebilmesi için altında dönen yuvarlak nesne
senses.example: A bicycle has two wheels.

senses.definition: at what time
senses.definitionTranslation: hangi zamanda
senses.example: When is your birthday?

senses.definition: what or which time
senses.definitionTranslation: ne ya da hangi zaman
senses.example: Since when have you lived here?

senses.definition: at the time that
senses.definitionTranslation: … olduğu zamanda
senses.example: Call me when you arrive.

senses.definition: at any time that; every time that
senses.definitionTranslation: … olduğu herhangi bir zamanda; … olduğu her seferinde
senses.example: Call me whenever you need help.

senses.definition: in or to what place
senses.definitionTranslation: hangi yerde ya da hangi yere
senses.example: Where do you live?

senses.definition: in or at the place in which
senses.definitionTranslation: … olduğu yerde
senses.example: This is the house where I was born.

senses.definition: used to compare two different facts
senses.definitionTranslation: iki farklı gerçeği karşılaştırmak için kullanılır
senses.example: She likes coffee, whereas I prefer tea.
senses.exampleTranslation: O kahve severken ben çayı tercih ederim.

senses.definition: in or to any place
senses.definitionTranslation: herhangi bir yerde ya da herhangi bir yere
senses.example: Sit wherever you like.

senses.definition: used to talk about a choice between two possibilities
senses.definitionTranslation: iki olasılık arasındaki bir seçimden söz etmek için kullanılır
senses.example: I don't know whether he will come.

senses.definition: used to ask about one of a group; also: used to refer to a thing already mentioned
senses.definitionTranslation: bir grubun içinden birini sormak için kullanılır; ayrıca: daha önce sözü geçen bir şeyi belirtmek için kullanılır
senses.example: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
senses.exampleTranslation: Hangisini tercih edersin, çay mı kahve mi?

senses.definition: used to ask about one of a group
senses.definitionTranslation: bir grubun içinden birini sormak için kullanılır
senses.example: Which bus goes to the airport?

senses.definition: during the time that
senses.definitionTranslation: … olduğu süre içinde
senses.example: He called while I was cooking.

senses.definition: a period of time
senses.definitionTranslation: bir süre
senses.example: I waited for a while.

senses.definition: to speak very quietly
senses.definitionTranslation: çok alçak sesle konuşmak
senses.example: She whispered something in my ear.

senses.definition: a very quiet voice
senses.definitionTranslation: çok alçak bir ses
senses.example: He spoke in a whisper.

senses.definition: having the colour of snow or milk
senses.definitionTranslation: kar ya da süt renginde olan
senses.example: He has a white car.

senses.definition: the colour of snow or milk
senses.definitionTranslation: karın ya da sütün rengi
senses.example: She was dressed in white.

senses.definition: used to ask about a person; also: used to refer to a person already mentioned
senses.definitionTranslation: bir kişi hakkında soru sormak için kullanılır; ayrıca: daha önce sözü geçen bir kişiyi belirtmek için kullanılır
senses.example: Who is that girl?

senses.definition: complete; all of something
senses.definitionTranslation: tam; bir şeyin hepsi
senses.example: I ate the whole pizza.

senses.definition: all of something
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin hepsi
senses.example: I spent the whole of my holiday reading.

senses.definition: used instead of "who" as the object of a verb or preposition
senses.definitionTranslation: bir fiilin ya da edatın nesnesi olarak "who" yerine kullanılır
senses.example: To whom should I send the letter?

senses.definition: used to ask who something belongs to
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin kime ait olduğunu sormak için kullanılır
senses.example: Whose bag is this?

senses.definition: used to ask who something belongs to
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin kime ait olduğunu sormak için kullanılır
senses.example: Whose is this coat?

senses.definition: for what reason
senses.definitionTranslation: hangi sebeple
senses.example: Why are you late?

senses.definition: measuring a large distance from one side to the other
senses.definitionTranslation: bir yanından öbür yanına kadar olan mesafesi büyük
senses.example: The river is very wide here.

senses.definition: by a lot of people; in a lot of places
senses.definitionTranslation: birçok insan tarafından; birçok yerde
senses.example: English is widely spoken.

senses.definition: the woman that a man is married to
senses.definitionTranslation: bir erkeğin evli olduğu kadın
senses.example: His wife is a teacher.

senses.definition: living or growing in nature, not controlled by people
senses.definitionTranslation: insanlar tarafından kontrol edilmeden doğada yaşayan ya da yetişen
senses.example: We saw wild animals in Africa.

senses.definition: wild animals and plants
senses.definitionTranslation: yabani hayvanlar ve bitkiler
senses.example: The park is full of wildlife.

senses.definition: used to talk about the future
senses.definitionTranslation: gelecekten söz etmek için kullanılır
senses.example: I will call you tomorrow.

senses.definition: the ability to decide what to do; also: a legal document about your property after death
senses.definitionTranslation: ne yapacağına karar verme gücü; ayrıca: ölümden sonra mallarının ne olacağını belirten yasal belge
senses.example: She has a strong will.

senses.definition: happy to do something
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyi yapmaktan mutlu olan
senses.example: Are you willing to help?

senses.definition: to be the best in a game or competition
senses.definitionTranslation: bir oyunda ya da yarışmada en iyisi olmak
senses.example: Our team won the match.

senses.definition: a victory
senses.definitionTranslation: zafer
senses.example: The team had three wins this season.
senses.exampleTranslation: Takım bu sezon üç galibiyet aldı.

senses.definition: air that moves quickly
senses.definitionTranslation: hızla hareket eden hava
senses.example: The wind is very strong today.

senses.definition: (of a road or river) to have many bends; also: to turn something round and round
senses.definitionTranslation: (yol ya da nehir için) çok kıvrımlı olmak; ayrıca: bir şeyi döndürüp durmak
senses.example: The road winds through the mountains.

senses.definition: an opening in a wall with glass in it
senses.definitionTranslation: bir duvardaki, camlı açıklık
senses.example: Open the window, please.

senses.definition: an alcoholic drink made from grapes
senses.definitionTranslation: üzümden yapılan alkollü içecek
senses.example: Would you like a glass of wine?

senses.definition: one of the parts of a bird, insect or plane used for flying
senses.definitionTranslation: bir kuşun, böceğin ya da uçağın uçmaya yarayan parçalarından biri
senses.example: The bird hurt its wing.

senses.definition: a person or team that wins
senses.definitionTranslation: kazanan kişi ya da takım
senses.example: The winner gets a prize.

senses.definition: the coldest season of the year
senses.definitionTranslation: yılın en soğuk mevsimi
senses.example: It snows a lot in winter.

senses.definition: a long thin piece of metal
senses.definitionTranslation: uzun, ince bir metal parçası
senses.example: The wires were cut.

senses.definition: able to make good decisions because of experience and knowledge
senses.definitionTranslation: deneyimi ve bilgisi sayesinde iyi kararlar verebilen
senses.example: My grandmother is very wise.

senses.definition: to want something that is not likely or possible
senses.definitionTranslation: olası olmayan ya da mümkün olmayan bir şeyi istemek
senses.example: I wish I could speak French.

senses.definition: a desire or hope for something
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şey için duyulan arzu ya da umut
senses.example: Make a wish!

senses.definition: together with somebody or something; also: having something
senses.definitionTranslation: biriyle ya da bir şeyle birlikte; ayrıca: bir şeye sahip olarak
senses.example: I went to the cinema with my friends.

senses.definition: inside a period of time or an area
senses.definitionTranslation: bir zaman diliminin ya da bir alanın içinde
senses.example: The package will arrive within three days.

senses.definition: not having or using something
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeye sahip olmadan ya da bir şeyi kullanmadan
senses.example: I drink my coffee without sugar.

senses.definition: a person who sees something happen
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin olduğunu gören kişi
senses.example: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident.

senses.definition: to see something happen
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin olduğunu görmek
senses.example: Did anyone witness the accident?

senses.definition: an adult female person
senses.definitionTranslation: yetişkin kadın
senses.example: A woman asked me for directions.

senses.definition: to want to know something
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyi bilmek istemek
senses.example: I wonder what time it is.

senses.definition: a feeling of surprise and admiration; also: something wonderful
senses.definitionTranslation: şaşkınlık ve hayranlık duygusu; ayrıca: harika bir şey
senses.example: The pyramids are one of the wonders of the world.

senses.definition: very good
senses.definitionTranslation: çok iyi
senses.example: We had a wonderful time.

senses.definition: the hard material that trees are made of; also: a small forest
senses.definitionTranslation: ağaçları oluşturan sert madde; ayrıca: küçük bir orman
senses.example: The table is made of wood.

senses.definition: made of wood
senses.definitionTranslation: tahtadan yapılmış
senses.example: We have a wooden floor.

senses.definition: the soft hair of sheep, used to make clothes
senses.definitionTranslation: koyunların giysi yapımında kullanılan yumuşak tüyü
senses.example: This sweater is made of wool.

senses.definition: a unit of language with a meaning
senses.definitionTranslation: anlamı olan bir dil birimi
senses.example: What does this word mean?

senses.definition: to do a job; also: (of a machine) to operate correctly
senses.definitionTranslation: bir iş yapmak; ayrıca: (makine için) doğru şekilde işlemek
senses.example: My mother works in a hospital.

senses.definition: a job; also: the place where you do a job
senses.definitionTranslation: bir iş; ayrıca: bir işi yaptığın yer
senses.example: I go to work by bus.

senses.definition: a person who works
senses.definitionTranslation: çalışan kişi
senses.example: The factory has 200 workers.

senses.definition: having a job; also: connected with work
senses.definitionTranslation: bir işi olan; ayrıca: işle ilgili
senses.example: My working hours are nine to five.

senses.definition: the earth, with all its countries and people
senses.definitionTranslation: bütün ülkeleri ve insanlarıyla yeryüzü
senses.example: I want to travel around the world.

senses.definition: affecting or happening in all parts of the world
senses.definitionTranslation: dünyanın her yerini etkileyen ya da her yerinde olan
senses.example: The film was a worldwide success.

senses.definition: in all parts of the world
senses.definitionTranslation: dünyanın her yerinde
senses.example: The company sells its products worldwide.

senses.definition: unhappy because you think something bad might happen
senses.definitionTranslation: kötü bir şey olabileceğini düşündüğü için mutsuz
senses.example: I'm worried about my exam.

senses.definition: to keep thinking about problems or bad things that might happen
senses.definitionTranslation: sorunları ya da olabilecek kötü şeyleri düşünüp durmak
senses.example: Don't worry, everything will be fine.

senses.definition: the state of worrying; also: something that makes you worry
senses.definitionTranslation: endişelenme hâli; ayrıca: seni endişelendiren şey
senses.example: Money is a big worry for them.
senses.exampleTranslation: Para onlar için büyük bir endişe kaynağı.

senses.definition: more bad
senses.definitionTranslation: daha kötü
senses.example: The weather is worse today than yesterday.

senses.definition: less well
senses.definitionTranslation: daha kötü bir şekilde
senses.example: He played worse than last time.

senses.definition: something worse
senses.definitionTranslation: daha kötü olan şey
senses.example: The situation changed for the worse.

senses.definition: most bad
senses.definitionTranslation: en kötü
senses.example: It was the worst day of my life.

senses.definition: most badly
senses.definitionTranslation: en kötü şekilde
senses.example: Who played worst?

senses.definition: the most serious or unpleasant thing
senses.definitionTranslation: en ciddi ya da en hoş olmayan şey
senses.example: The worst is over now.

senses.definition: having a particular value; also: good enough to do
senses.definitionTranslation: belirli bir değeri olan; ayrıca: yapılmaya değecek kadar iyi
senses.example: The museum is worth visiting.

senses.definition: the value of something; also: an amount of something worth a particular sum
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyin değeri; ayrıca: belirli bir tutar eden miktarda bir şey
senses.example: He bought 50 euros' worth of food.

senses.definition: used to talk about imagined situations or to ask politely
senses.definitionTranslation: hayalî durumlardan söz etmek ya da kibarca bir şey istemek için kullanılır
senses.example: Would you like some tea?

senses.definition: an injury to the body, often from a weapon
senses.definitionTranslation: çoğunlukla bir silahın açtığı vücut yarası
senses.example: The soldier had a wound in his arm.

senses.definition: to injure somebody, often with a weapon
senses.definitionTranslation: birini çoğunlukla bir silahla yaralamak
senses.example: Two people were wounded in the attack.

senses.definition: used to show surprise or admiration
senses.definitionTranslation: şaşkınlık ya da hayranlık göstermek için kullanılır
senses.example: Wow! What a beautiful house!
senses.exampleTranslation: Vay canına! Ne güzel bir ev!

senses.definition: to cover something in paper or cloth
senses.definitionTranslation: bir şeyi kâğıtla ya da kumaşla örtmek
senses.example: I wrapped the present in red paper.

senses.definition: to put letters or words on paper or a screen
senses.definitionTranslation: kâğıda ya da ekrana harfler veya kelimeler koymak
senses.example: Write your name here.

senses.definition: a person who writes books or articles
senses.definitionTranslation: kitap ya da makale yazan kişi
senses.example: She is a famous writer.

senses.definition: the activity of writing, or written words
senses.definitionTranslation: yazma etkinliği ya da yazılmış kelimeler
senses.example: Her writing is hard to read.

senses.definition: expressed in writing
senses.definitionTranslation: yazıyla ifade edilmiş
senses.example: We have a written exam tomorrow.

senses.definition: not correct; also: not right or good
senses.definitionTranslation: doğru olmayan; ayrıca: uygun ya da iyi olmayan
senses.example: Your answer is wrong.

senses.definition: in a way that is not correct
senses.definitionTranslation: doğru olmayan bir şekilde
senses.example: You spelled my name wrong.

senses.definition: behaviour that is not morally right
senses.definitionTranslation: ahlaken doğru olmayan davranış
senses.example: Children must learn the difference between right and wrong.
senses.exampleTranslation: Çocuklar doğru ile yanlış arasındaki farkı öğrenmeli.

senses.definition: an area next to a building; also: a unit of length (about 91 cm)
senses.definitionTranslation: bir binanın yanındaki alan; ayrıca: bir uzunluk birimi (yaklaşık 91 cm)
senses.example: The children are playing in the yard.

senses.definition: (informal) yes
senses.definitionTranslation: (gündelik dilde) evet
senses.example: "Are you coming?" "Yeah."

senses.definition: a period of twelve months
senses.definitionTranslation: on iki aylık süre
senses.example: I have lived here for five years.

senses.definition: having the colour of lemons or butter
senses.definitionTranslation: limon ya da tereyağı renginde olan
senses.example: She has a yellow bike.

senses.definition: the colour of lemons or butter
senses.definitionTranslation: limonun ya da tereyağının rengi
senses.example: Yellow is a happy colour.

senses.definition: used to give a positive answer
senses.definitionTranslation: olumlu bir cevap vermek için kullanılır
senses.example: "Do you like it?" "Yes, I do."

senses.definition: on the day before today
senses.definitionTranslation: bugünden önceki günde
senses.example: I saw her yesterday.

senses.definition: the day before today
senses.definitionTranslation: bugünden önceki gün
senses.example: Yesterday was Monday.

senses.definition: until now (in negatives and questions)
senses.definitionTranslation: şimdiye kadar (olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde)
senses.example: Have you finished yet?

senses.definition: but; despite this
senses.definitionTranslation: ama; buna rağmen
senses.example: It's a small car, yet it's very comfortable.
senses.exampleTranslation: Küçük bir araba ama çok rahat.

senses.definition: used for the person or people you are talking to
senses.definitionTranslation: konuştuğun kişi ya da kişiler için kullanılır
senses.example: Are you ready?

senses.definition: not old
senses.definitionTranslation: yaşlı olmayan
senses.example: She is too young to drive.

senses.definition: young people; also: baby animals
senses.definitionTranslation: gençler; ayrıca: yavru hayvanlar
senses.example: The bird is feeding its young.

senses.definition: belonging to you
senses.definitionTranslation: sana ait olan
senses.example: Is this your bag?

senses.definition: the one belonging to you
senses.definitionTranslation: sana ait olan
senses.example: Is this pen yours?

senses.definition: used when "you" is both the subject and the object
senses.definitionTranslation: "you" hem özne hem nesne olduğunda kullanılır
senses.example: Be careful, don't hurt yourself.

senses.definition: the time of life when you are young; also: young people
senses.definitionTranslation: hayatın genç olunan dönemi; ayrıca: gençler
senses.example: He was a good athlete in his youth.

senses.definition: the number 0
senses.definitionTranslation: 0 sayısı
senses.example: The temperature fell below zero.

senses.definition: an area with a particular feature or use
senses.definitionTranslation: belirli bir özelliği ya da kullanımı olan alan
senses.example: This is a no-parking zone.
